answer: Admission is gated by a one-slot-per-epoch inlet. The applicant must present a single-use token minted only by a rotating oasis of established attestors, each locking stake equal to 30 days of median rewards. Validity requires three disjoint endorsement paths that traverse a karst of independent stake layers; shared keys or funding merge the paths, void the token, and slash each endorser 20%. Creating N identities then requires N reserved attestors, not N free accounts.
